proof: For the SIX actually materialised commodity classes: each finite stock starts full, cannot charge/divert, shares only its exclusive final obligation. Sum initial stocks equals fixed annual demand and all final stocks nonnegative, so every final stock=0 and each annual throughput equals its own Q. For constant unit price, sum_t w_t*c*q_t=c*Q. Timing can vary but cannot change this constant. Animal waste has no materialised qualified resource: missing is not zero and the proof is conditional for it.
